messages.subject: R/qtl version 1.27-10
messages.body_plain:
A new version of R/qtl (1.27-10) has been released at its web site
(http://www.rqtl.org) and will be on CRAN shortly.

The main change is the implementation (by Laura Shannon and Brian
Yandell) of tools for advanced backcrosses/intercrosses.  See the
tutorial at http://www.rqtl.org/tutorials/bcsft.pdf

See http://www.rqtl.org/STATUS.txt for a complete list of changes.

Karl Broman
kbr...@biostat.wisc.edu
